# National Dental Care

> National Dental Care is a multi-location dental clinic network across Hyderabad and Bangalore offering comprehensive dental services from preventive care to cosmetic and surgical procedures.

With 13+ clinic locations across major Hyderabad neighborhoods (KPHB, Madinaguda, Srinagar Colony, Gachibowli, Kompally, Nallagandla) and Bangalore areas, National Dental Care provides specialized treatments including implants, orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry, and pediatric care with emphasis on patient safety and infection control.

## Key Topics

- Dental Implants
- Orthodontics
- Clear Aligners
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Root Canal Treatment
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Teeth Whitening
- Preventive Dentistry
- Dental Tourism
- Hyderabad Dentist
- Restorative Dentistry
- Invisalign
- Wisdom Teeth Extraction
- Smile Makeover
